_comment: The ONE map of known model ids, read by the CLI, the agent and the web UI (consts.json models.file; docs/hub/cards.md, "The Agent line"). A card's **Agent:** line carries a model id; every reader takes its provider, family and display name from here and never parses the id. family is what the standup groups by and matches to a kept window; name is the display name; coAuthor, where present, is the name a commit's Co-Authored-By trailer carries, so a trailer maps to an id by lookup. An id with no row reads as written, with no provider or family, and is left out of any cost. Adding a model is one row.
